resource_type: # WARNING (owner decision 2026-08-22 / Infra backlog E7.T32): this file is NOT applied to DNS.
# No pipeline consumes it into Technitium. tofu/dns/ is a stub with an empty state that has never managed a record.
# NetworkService (src/homelab_gitops/domain/network.py) only appends rows here and reads IPs back as an allocation ledger.
# scripts/technitium_manager.py convert-csv can render it to tofu JSON but nothing runs that and nothing applies the result.
# Technitium serves 189 records today; the 127 infra.plexplease.com records are owned by external-dns (--policy=sync).
# Completing tofu/dns/ and applying it would DELETE those records. Leave the module as-is. Host DNS is hand-managed in Technitium.
# These comment rows sit below the header on purpose: every reader is csv.DictReader; a '#' first field matches no resource_type
# and convert-csv skips it as unknown. Keep these lines comma-free or they will split into columns.
